proposals.before: Tian Dan pretended to bind his slave and followed some youths to the county court, intending to meet with the magistrate and kill the slave.
proposals.after: Tian Dan pretended to bind his slave and, accompanied by some young men, went to the county court, intending to request (as a pretext) that the slave be executed.
proposals.reason: The Chinese 欲謁殺奴 is the feigned petition to have the slave killed, not an intention to kill the slave; the magistrate is killed in the next sentence.

decisions.reason: 欲謁殺奴 means he meant to petition for the slave’s official execution, not to kill the slave himself; the next unit 因擊殺令 shows the magistrate is the one struck dead, so the proposed literal correctly restores that petition-pretext reading.
